description: This file is a PHP source file defining the Account controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles user account page logic, including loading language translations, managing session tokens, setting up breadcrumbs, and rendering the account view with various links and data.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: The Account controller class manages the user account page, including displaying user information, handling navigation, and managing session tokens.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method for the Account class that initializes the account page, verifies login status and customer token, prepares breadcrumb navigation, gathers various account-related links, and renders the account view template.
